nodes.name: Every 5 Minutes
nodes.notes: Evaluates all alert rules every 5 minutes.

nodes.name: Node Exporter (CPU/Mem)
nodes.notes: Pulls host CPU + memory utilization (n8n container sidecar exposes node_exporter metrics).

nodes.name: Evaluate Alert Rules
nodes.notes: Six alert rules: WF_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH (>10%/1h), WF_SLOW_EXECUTION (>5min avg), N8N_QUEUE_DEPTH_HIGH (>100), WF_NOT_EXECUTED_24H (scheduled but idle), N8N_CPU_HIGH (>80%), N8N_MEMORY_HIGH (>80%). Returns one item per firing alert.

nodes.name: Send to Slack #ops-alerts
nodes.notes: All firing alerts go to #ops-alerts (warnings + critical).

nodes.name: Page On-Call (Critical)
nodes.notes: CRITICAL severity only — pages the on-call engineer via PagerDuty. Dedup key prevents alert storms when the same rule fires across multiple cycles.

nodes.name: Log Alert to Audit
nodes.notes: Every firing alert is persisted to the audit log for post-incident review.

meta.description: Evaluates 6 alert rules every 5 minutes: failure rate > 10%/1h, execution time > 5 min, queue depth > 100, scheduled workflow idle > 24h, CPU > 80%, memory > 80%. Firing alerts go to #ops-alerts Slack; CRITICAL alerts also page PagerDuty. All alerts are logged to the audit table.
